STORY: "It's been a wild ride for software companies."

:: Sources say Silver ‌Lake is in talks to acquire Workday

"Silver Lake has been in talks with Workday for a take-private deal."

:: New York / August 13, 2026

:: Milana Vinn, Correspondent

"Sources have told us that talks have been going on for months, but we are yet to establish how advanced these discussions are. This would be a really significant deal because software deals have been largely on the sidelines this year.

"Earlier this month, Silver Lake had completed their $55 billion acquisition of Electronic Arts, which is a really significant deal as well. For that deal, they had partnered with their co-investors. So I assume, and we hear from sources that that's likely the case. They will partner with a co-investor for a take-private of Workday."
